A WebSearch summary claimed some category pages call pieces streetwear, but that wasn't fetched. Off_category under this run's rule; a human may override.
GBP store (hoodies £90–£125); us.namedcollective.com 301-redirects to the main site. No USD prices, so none are stored.

Hoodie product copy (hoodies feed body_html): 'Designed in London by NAMED COLLECTIVE®… Our signature oversized fit… Full-length, two-way zip with custom NAMED hardware… Mindfully made from premium 73% organic cotton, 27% recycled polyester fleece' on most rhinestone and embroidered zips (e.g. Poison Rhinestone Zip Hoodie, Malfunction Rhinestone Zip Hoodie); some faux-fur styles are 100% polyester. Several have detachable ears or detachable faux-fur hood trim.

Hoodies collection description (https://namedcollective.com/collections/hoodies.json): 'made from high quality, heavy fabrics… oversized hoodies, super cropped hooded tops, and flattering sculpt sweatshirts… detachable bunny ears and lace detailing, or our darker sh*t, which features rhinestones, camo, and bold graphics… Pair with our signature sweatpants for the ultimate tracksuit set'.
